description: Ministry of Defence - Order to establish firing ranges in Kahagolla, Haputhale D/S Division, Badulla District be known as 100 meters Small Arms Firing at Diyathalawa Air Force Training School and in Morawewa, Morawewa D/S Division, Trincomalee District be known as 300 meters Small Arms Firing Range at Morawewa Air Force Camp and the Firing Range Regulations - 1983
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the establishment and regulation of firing ranges under the Firing Ranges and Military Training Act. It contains legal orders, regulations, and statutory instruments made by the Minister of Defence under specific legislative authority (Act No. 24 of 1951 and constitutional provisions). The content focuses on regulatory frameworks, compliance requirements, and legal procedures rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or other specialized categories.
